name: mdl
description: /mdl big|medium|small: switch the session's model and effort level together, from three presets you set in /config

bigModel.title: big: model
bigModel.description: The model /mdl big switches to, as /model takes it: an alias such as opus, sonnet, haiku or fable (opus[1m] for the 1M context), or a full model ID. Unset, /mdl big says it isn't configured.

bigEffort.title: big: effort
bigEffort.description: The effort level /mdl big sets, as /effort takes it: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or auto (the model's own default). Unset, /mdl big says it isn't configured.
